name: GitHub (Rui)
description: Manage GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions in Cindy. Supports github.com. Unofficial personal copy of the official GitHub plugin; authenticates with a personal access token you paste in its settings.
whenToUse: Only for github.com repos and links (GitLab instances: use GitLab). Use me for GitHub issues and PRs, code reviews, merges, repos, branches, commits, files, Actions, releases, search, and artifact or log downloads. Needs a personal access token saved in my settings (no GitHub CLI login).
author: Rui Valim

secrets.label: GitHub personal access token
secrets.hint: Paste a personal access token (ghp_... or github_pat_...). It is only injected into requests to api.github.com.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the GitHub operations this plugin offers (117 in total, covering issues / pulls / repo / commits / actions / releases / search / users / orgs / events / notifications / gists / git_data / reactions / meta). Without category, return a category overview (name + count + description); with category, return the name, description, and parameters of every operation in it.

category.description: Category name, from the overview (e.g. issues / pulls / actions)

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run one specific GitHub operation. name comes from list_tools; pass args as a JSON object following that operation's parameter notes. Repo-level operations must pass owner and repo explicitly (when working in a git repository, derive them from `git remote get-url origin`). By default the response drops API link fields (html_url is kept) to limit size; pass raw=true for the original JSON. Results over 50KB are written to the session work directory automatically and only the file path is returned (out_file can set the path). Download operations (Actions artifacts / log zips) require the caller to put the absolute path of the target directory in the top-level save_dir parameter of ghost_call.

args.description: Operation parameters; when unsure, pass {} to get an error response with the parameter notes

raw.description: true = return the original GitHub JSON (API link fields not stripped); default false

out_file.description: Optional: write the full result JSON to this relative path in the session work directory (e.g. tmp/gh-result.json) and return only the file path. Use it for large results that a script will process. Results over 50KB are written to disk and returned as a path even without it
